spacing_and_layout.marketing_page: Generous spacing (p-12, p-24), asymmetrical bento grid for feature highlights. Strict Swiss alignment.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Dense BENTO grid (gap-6), flat solid surfaces with 1px border and no shadow. No glassmorphism in clinical data context.
spacing_and_layout.surgical_mode: Control Room Grid, dense data, edge-to-edge full screen mapping. Floating panels over 3D context.

components.button: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white rounded-md font-medium tracking-wide transition-colors
components.panel: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg p-6
components.layer_control: flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0

components.rules: Use Shadcn Slider for layer opacities. Use Checkbox for toggling anatomy layers.

motion.vitals_pulse: animate-pulse for active vitals monitor heart rate

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` for clinical, highly legible icons.

Implement the Full-Body 3D Explorer with a Photoshop-style layer control panel. Include Shadcn Checkbox (visibility) and Slider (opacity) for each anatomical layer (Skin, Muscle, Nerves, Arteries, Veins, Bones, Organs).

Build the Surgical Mode as an immersive, edge-to-edge UI. Use a dark theme (Deep Slate) for the OR-style vitals monitor overlay. Use JetBrains Mono or monospace font for the real-time HR, BP, SpO2 readings.
Strictly avoid Teal (#1B93A4) or generic purple/mint tech gradients. Use Stark Whites, Deep Slates (#0F172A), and Cobalt Blue (#2563EB) for an authoritative clinical aesthetic.
Apply solid flat backgrounds with crisp 1px borders for dashboard widgets instead of soft glassmorphism, ensuring optimal data legibility.
Embed `data-testid` on all buttons, layer toggles, tab triggers, inputs, and sliders to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
